record.question: Which of the following statements is correct regarding Government servants and demonstrations near Government offices?
options: Government servants may freely mingle with demonstrators.
Government servants should remain neutral and avoid the demonstrators or crowd near the place of demonstration.
Government servants are encouraged to witness demonstrations during office hours.
Government servants should leave their offices whenever a demonstration passes by.
